objs.name: document
objs.description: Core artifact representing policies, guidelines, work instructions, and other documents.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment to a Document; may include supplementary artifacts.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary information attached to a Document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed changes to an existing Document.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object containing information that can be attached to a Document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Categories of documents (e.g., Policies, Guidelines, Work Instructions).

objs.name: template
objs.description: Document templates defined for each Document Type.

objs.name: language
objs.description: Language in which a Document can be translated.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person or role interacting with Documents (e.g., Authors, Reviewers).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Creation of a new Document.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Editing of a Document.

evts.name: attach_information_object
evts.description: Attachment of a new Information Object to a Document.

evts.name: attach_template
evts.description: Selection of a Template for a Document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Release of a Document with signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Review step in the release process.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of a released Document into another Language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release of a translated Document.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribution of a Document to Readers.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Distribution of a Document by Email to designated Users/Groups.

evts.name: acknowledge_distribution
evts.description: Acknowledgement of Distribution by recipients.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a Change Proposal for a Document.

evts.name: review_change_proposal
evts.description: Review of a Change Proposal.

evts.name: apply_change_proposal
evts.description: Apply a Change Proposal to a Document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change Proposal.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Extend validity of a Document's version.

evts.name: check_validity_extension
evts.description: Check validity extension for a Document.

evts.name: confirm_validity_extension
evts.description: Confirm validity extension and set new validity date.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Override process (AKS) for a Document.

evts.name: create_aks_request
evts.description: Create an AKS request for a Document.

evts.name: process_aks
evts.description: Process an AKS for a Document.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Invalidate a Document and archive.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive a Document and its Attachments.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivate an invalidated Document.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a reactivation request for a Document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: Process a reactivation of a Document.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Create a new version of a Document.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Publish a released Document.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Signatures by workflow participants during release.
